en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali Majluwayh from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from Abi Junub from his father from Umar b. [Abi] al-Miqdam from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said: “
Where is his cornelian ring? If he had been wearing that, he would not have been lashed.”
